items.title: 13.2 Derivative as the Limit of a Difference Quotient (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichhle section mein humne tangent ka slope ek limit ki shakal mein nikala. Ab kitab isi limit ko ek aur zaaviye (angle) se dekhti hai: rate of change, yani tabdeeli ki raftaar. Aur yahin is limit ko woh naam milta hai jo poore unit ka unwaan (title) hai: derivative.
Farz karein \(f\) ek real valued function hai jo interval \((x, x_{1}) \subseteq D_{f}\) (yani \(f\) ke domain ke andar) continuous hai. To difference quotient (farq ki nisbat)

blocks.text_alt: f of x 1 minus f of x, over x 1 minus x; expression (i)

blocks.text: \(f\) ki value mein average rate of change (ausat raftaar-e-tabdeeli) ko zahir karta hai, independent variable \(x\) ki value mein \(x_{1} - x\) ki tabdeeli ke muqable mein.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Expression (i) ko yun parhiye: output mein kitni tabdeeli hui, divide by input mein kitni tabdeeli hui. Geometry mein yeh points \((x, f(x))\) aur \((x_{1}, f(x_{1}))\) se guzarne wali secant ka slope hai, wahi jo 13.1 mein dekha.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(f(x) = x^{2}\) lein, aur \(x\) ko \(1\) se \(3\) tak le jayein:
\[\dfrac{f(3) - f(1)}{3 - 1} = \dfrac{9 - 1}{2} = 4\]
Matlab is interval par \(x\) ke har ek unit ke badle \(f\) ausatan \(4\) unit badhta hai. Isay "average" is liye kehte hain ke \(1\) ke qareeb \(f\) aahista badhta hai aur \(3\) ke qareeb tez; \(4\) sirf majmooi (overall) raftaar hai, kisi ek point ki raftaar nahin.
Ab agar \(x_{1}\) ko \(x\) ke qareeb se qareeb tar laya jaye, to

blocks.text_alt: the limit, as x 1 tends to x, of f of x 1 minus f of x, over x 1 minus x

blocks.text: agar yeh limit maujood ho (provided this limit exists), to isay \(x\) ke lehaaz se \(f\) ka instantaneous rate of change (kisi ek lamhe ya ek point par tabdeeli ki raftaar) kehte hain aur \(f'(x)\) likhte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Average aur instantaneous ka farq ek misaal se samjhiye. Ek bus 2 ghante mein 120 km chalti hai, to us ki average speed 60 km/h hui. Lekin raaste mein kisi lamhe woh signal par khadi thi (0 km/h) aur kisi lamhe 80 km/h par bhaag rahi thi. Speedometer jo kisi ek lamhe par dikhata hai, woh instantaneous speed hai.
Yeh instantaneous speed kaise nikalein? Chhote se chhote waqfe (interval) ki average speed lete jayein: 1 minute, phir 1 second, phir second ka hazarwan hissa... Jis value ki taraf yeh averages ja rahe hain, wahi instantaneous speed hai. Yahi kaam limit \(x_{1} \to x\) karti hai.
Agar hum \(x_{1} = x + \delta x\) likhein, yani \(x_{1} - x = \delta x\), to expression (i) yun likha ja sakta hai:

blocks.text_alt: f of x plus delta x minus f of x, over delta x; expression (ii)
the limit, as delta x tends to 0, of f of x plus delta x minus f of x, over delta x; expression (iii)

blocks.text: agar yeh limit maujood ho, to isay \(x\) ke lehaaz se \(f\) ka derivative (ya \(f\) ka differential coefficient) kehte hain aur \(f'(x)\) se zahir karte hain (parhein "\(f\) prime of \(x\)"). \(f'\) ka domain un tamaam \(x\) par mushtamil hai jin ke liye yeh limit maujood ho. Agar \(x \in D_{f}\) ho aur \(f'(x)\) maujood ho, to kehte hain ke \(f\) point \(x\) par differentiable hai. Aur \(f'\) nikalne ke amal ko differentiation kehte hain. Yahi is poore unit ka naam hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
Remember
blocks.text:
Derivative ki definition (upar wale paragraph ka hamara khulasa):
\[f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0} \dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\]
basharte ke limit maujood ho (provided the limit exists).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(x_{1}\) ki jagah \(x + \delta x\) kyun likha? Is tarah dono inputs ke darmiyan faasle ko apna naam mil jata hai, \(\delta x\), aur "\(x_{1}\) \(x\) ke qareeb jata hai" ki jagah aasaan jumla aa jata hai: "\(\delta x\) zero ke qareeb jata hai". Baqi kuch nahin badla: (i) aur (ii) ek hi fraction hai, bas do tarah likha gaya.
Ab (iii) ko 13.1 ki equation (2) se milaiye. Bilkul wahi limit hai! Matlab derivative \(f'(x)\) graph par point \((x, f(x))\) par tangent ka slope bhi hai. Ek hi cheez, do nazariye: graph wale ke liye "slope", tabdeeli wale ke liye "rate of change".

rows: us point par curve kitna dhalwan hai

yahi naam aur nishan ab aage chalega
waqt ke lehaaz se position ka derivative
blocks.caption: Ek limit, kai naam (hamara khulasa, kitab mein nahin)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Aaiye apna pehla derivative seedha (iii) se nikaalein, \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ke liye:
\[f(x+\delta x) - f(x) = (x+\delta x)^{2} - x^{2}\]
\[= 2x\,\delta x + \delta x^{2}\]
\[\dfrac{2x\,\delta x + \delta x^{2}}{\delta x} = 2x + \delta x\]
\[f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}(2x + \delta x) = 2x\]
Ab \(x = -1\) rakhein: \(f'(-1) = -2\). Yeh wahi slope hai jo Example 1 mein \(y = x^{2} - 2\) ke liye mila tha! Constant \(-2\) graph ko sirf neeche khiskata hai, us ka dhalwan nahin badalta, is liye slope wahi raha. Poora tareeqa 13.3 mein aayega.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(f(x) = x^{2}\) ke liye \(f'(x) = 2x\) hai. To \(x = 0\) par slope kya hai, aur graph par is ka kya matlab hai?
Jawab: \(f'(0) = 0\). Parabola ka sab se neecha point \((0, 0)\) hai, wahan tangent bilkul ufqi (horizontal) hai, aur ufqi line ka slope zero hota hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Agar sawal kahe "derivative ki definition likhiye", to poori likhiye: limit (iii), alfaaz "provided the limit exists", nishan \(f'(x)\) aur naam "derivative (differential coefficient) of \(f\) with respect to \(x\)". Examiner khaas taur par "provided the limit exists" wali shart dhoondta hai; yeh chhoot jaye to number kat sakte hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Difference quotient (i) = average rate of change = secant ka slope.
2. Is ki limit jab \(x_{1} \to x\) (ya \(\delta x \to 0\)) = instantaneous rate of change = derivative \(f'(x)\) = tangent ka slope.
3. \(f'(x)\) ko "\(f\) prime of \(x\)" parhte hain; doosra naam \(f\) ka differential coefficient hai.
4. \(f\) point \(x\) par differentiable hai jab \(x \in D_{f}\) ho aur limit maujood ho. Aise tamaam \(x\) mil kar \(f'\) ka domain banate hain.
5. \(f'\) nikalne ke amal ko differentiation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(f'(x)\) ko "\(f\) zarb \(x'\)" samajhna. Dash \(f\) ka hissa hai: \(f'\) ek naya function hai, \(f\) ka derivative.
2. "Provided the limit exists" bhool jana. Limit hamesha maujood nahin hoti; 13.5 mein aap \(f(x) = |x|\) dekhenge jis ka \(x = 0\) par derivative nahin hota, kyun ke wahan graph ka nokeela kona (sharp corner) hai.
3. Average rate (poore interval par ek fraction) aur instantaneous rate (ek point par limit) ko ek hi cheez samajh lena.
4. \(\delta x \to 0\) ko \(\delta x = 0\) samajh kar pehle hi zero rakh dena; is se \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai.
